title: Create an owned nested project
requires: Disposable parent; selected permission mode supported by target.
commands: tadx content project create --environment <E> --parent-id <PARENT> --name <UNIQUE_NAME> --description "Live project fixture" --content-permissions <SUPPORTED_MODE> --json
assertions: Independent REST inventory finds exactly one child under requested parent with requested metadata.
Returned ID equals authoritative child ID; no unrelated hierarchy changes.
cleanup: Independent API delete exact empty project LUID.

title: Delete an exact empty project
requires: Disposable empty project plus same-name decoy under different parent.
assertions: Preview leaves project present.
Execution gives authoritative project absence; decoy and parent survive.
cleanup: Independent API cleanup only if owned ID remains after fresh observation.

title: Resolve an exact nested project path
requires: Nested hierarchy and duplicate leaf-name decoy.
assertions: Returned exact LUID, parent, owner, description, and content permission mode match independent REST oracle.
cleanup: None.

title: Discover the fixture project hierarchy
requires: Nested disposable hierarchy with two direct children and same-name child under different parent.
assertions: Exact child ID set and parent identities match independent REST hierarchy.
No same-name decoy from other parent; authoritative project paths preserve hierarchy.
cleanup: None.

title: Reparent an owned project hierarchy
requires: Mutable project containing child project and fixture content; separate destination Q.
assertions: REST confirms same project LUID now under Q; descendant parent links and content LUIDs remain intact.
Derived paths update; source/destination sibling projects unchanged.
cleanup: Delete child content, then child projects, then moved project by owned IDs.

title: Update project metadata and permission mode
requires: Per-test empty project; valid target-supported mode different from original.
commands: tadx content project update --environment <E> --id <PROJECT> --new-name <UPDATED_NAME> --description "Updated live fixture" --content-permissions <NEW_MODE> --json
assertions: Fresh REST read confirms same LUID with exact name, description, and permission mode.
Parent and unrelated project remain unchanged.
cleanup: Independent API delete owned project.

title: Recreate a portable bundle with explicit datasource mapping
assertions: Independent exact REST reads verify new definition identity, mapped datasource, all admitted saved business sections, default-metric identity, and every bundled metric specification.
Source definition and bundle bytes remain unchanged; source subscriptions are not recreated.
Returned source-to-destination identity mapping matches independently read remote objects.
cleanup: Delete every newly created subscription, variant, and definition by receipt-owned identities; verify absence.
notes: Portable baseline can map to a second equivalent datasource on the same site. An explicit cross-target version uses two target profiles, without hard-coded endpoints. Publish is create-only. Reconciliation verifies new object readback; it does not update or deduplicate existing definitions. Do not repeat publish to test a nonexistent no-op.

title: Pull the complete portable definition bundle
assertions: Compare the full portable definition document and complete metric LUID set against independent Pulse REST snapshots. Include default marker and complete metric specifications, including periods and included or excluded filters.
Bundle records source provenance and workspace-relative paths; excludes subscribers, PATs, tokens, metric values, and insights.
Independent remote snapshots remain unchanged.

Compare every admitted business section present in the fixture: specification, extension_options, representation_options, insights_options, comparisons, datasource_goals, related_links, certification, name, and description. Normalize documented provider defaults and volatile envelope metadata only.
cleanup: Remove isolated workspace bundle through harness-owned filesystem cleanup.

title: Create a definition from the eligible datasource

assertions: Independent GET definitions/{returned-id} proves requested measure, date, dimension, aggregation, and datasource persisted.
Independent definition-scoped metric listing eventually contains Tableau's default metric with matching ownership.
Receipt separates definition creation from any unavailable default-metric observation.
cleanup: Delete owned subscriptions, variants, and definition through independent Pulse REST; confirm absence.

title: Delete an owned definition
assertions: Independent exact REST GET confirms definition absence.
A sentinel definition remains readable; receipt does not claim unsupported cascade outcomes.
cleanup: Enumerate retained owned variants/subscriptions through independent REST and remove confirmed residual resources.

title: Read saved definition configuration

Site, datasource, and definition identities match the selected fixture.
cleanup: None.

cleanup: None.

Existing sentinel followers remain unchanged.
cleanup: DELETE the created subscription through independent REST; confirm absence.

assertions: Independent subscription read confirms the returned subscription binds the exact metric and group.

cleanup: Delete exact created subscription through REST.

Coverage of group-derived subscriptions remains explicit rather than universally complete.
cleanup: None.

cleanup: Remove residual owned variant through REST.

Independent GET of returned metric proves requested timeframe and filter plus original definition, datasource, and site.
Independent source metric snapshot remains unchanged; get-or-create outcome is reported truthfully.
cleanup: Delete variant only if the test created it; preserve any pre-existing matching metric.

No current metric value or generated insight is required.
cleanup: None.

title: List a definition's saved metric variants
assertions: Returned metric LUID set equals independent GET definitions/{id}/metrics.
Every returned metric belongs to the selected definition and datasource.
cleanup: None.

Package is actually larger than runtime direct-upload threshold; no lowered test threshold or internal transport bypass.
cleanup: Independent API deletes owned published LUID after terminal outcome; preserve upload-session/job IDs on unresolved outcome.
notes: Separate per-kind upload implementation warrants two cases. Run surgically for uploader, transport, or large-publish changes; exclude routine metadata-only selections.

requires: Valid pinned native fixture file; isolated destination project Q; no preexisting test name.
assertions: Direct REST finds exactly one new resource at Q with returned LUID and requested name.
Independent download contains authored native payload, known fields/data, and connection reference expectations.
No source object changes; no managed workspace artifact created implicitly.
cleanup: Independent API delete only returned, owned LUID.

requires: Destination object has payload version A; native fixture B has distinguishing schema/data; project-Q name decoy in another project.
assertions: Independent download proves payload B replaced A at exact destination.
Authoritative destination LUID and identity agree with receipt; unrelated decoy and source remain unchanged.
cleanup: Delete owned destination and workspace, if any.

Sidecar records exact source LUID, project, target, and clean baseline; reported artifact paths are relative.
cleanup: Delete W; no remote mutation.

assertions: Native workbook plus both direct published datasource artifacts exist with exact remote IDs.

Each payload remains native and unmodified.
cleanup: Delete W.

requires: Fixture workbook has embedded extract with recognizable rows and package marker; fresh W.
assertions: Native package/definition remains valid; embedded extract payload is omitted as defined by Tableau download API.
Independent requested-without-extract download confirms semantics; default pull separately proves extract-preserving path.
cleanup: Delete W.
notes: Explicitly protects action forwarding gap identified by offline audit AR-06; this is meaningful data acquisition behavior.

Metadata-only identities stay valid without invented REST LUIDs; inherited descriptions and upstream column tags retain correct provenance.
cleanup: None.
notes: Bounded Metadata readiness check runs before this test; absence is an explicit missing-capability result, never an empty-data pass.

assertions: Fresh direct REST read confirms requested owner and all supported changed metadata at same LUID.
Content payload, project, and unrelated fixture remain unchanged.
cleanup: Independent API delete owned resource, retaining account permission after owner transfer.

Fresh publication independently proves moved artifact remains usable and has expected payload.
Remote source fixture unchanged.
cleanup: Delete published LUID independently; remove both isolated workspaces.
notes: One representative real artifact proves integration. Full kind/path/conflict matrix belongs offline.

assertions: Preview leaves files unchanged; execution removes exact local artifact and sidecars.
Direct REST confirms source workbook and unrelated artifact remain intact.
cleanup: Delete W.
notes: Local operation with remote preservation oracle; no extra Tableau mutation.
